display_name: Japantown Parade Route (market bridge and shrine)
why: The elevated parade route above Japantown: a market bridge of food stands and stalls, a security room, a construction site, lifts up to the route and a small shrine, all dressed for Saburo Arasaka's funeral parade in q112. This proposal restores the everyday bazaar - stall keepers, shoppers, the market crowd, the cook's grill, construction staff, a two-officer NCPD post and the shrine's miko and priest - while leaving the parade barges, billboards, blockers, frozen spectator blobs and Arasaka parade security out.

open_questions: Does the kept open-world Japantown phase (wbr_jpn_phase, run by the kept global community phase) already keep the market crowd and cook alive at boot, making our re-activation redundant but harmless? Confirm on the tour that no second crowd spawns at the same spots.

Declaring #q112_pr_parade for the two shrine NPCs also instantiates the parade staging. Confirm the barge, player_blocker and background_npcs variant changes hide it cleanly and the shrine reads as an ordinary shrine, or drop the shrine pair and the prefab.
The 'avs' variant of #q112_pr_market appears with state 0 only in vanilla; confirm that 0 means parked parade AVs hidden (not shown).
The market security room is a quest infiltration room. Confirm with the door policy that its door and the #q112_01_market_security access point behave normally when the venue phase runs.

Whether Saburo is alive in this timeline is not stated in docs/design/gameplay-systems.md; either way the funeral parade cannot happen because the heist that kills him never does, but a canon answer would settle it.

communities.why: Background market crowd on the bridge (53 spots: benches, stalls, vending machines, bar lean, stairs). Vanilla's open-world Japantown phase already activates men/default while the parade barges are not running; re-issue it from the venue phase so the bridge is not empty if the district phase streams late. Activate is idempotent, but the tour should confirm no double crowd.
Female half of the same background market crowd (53 spots). Same vanilla open-world activation under the no-parade branch.

Food-stall keeper for the bridge market: 16 spots including stand_market_grill_spatula__cook and bar-rag clean. The community sits inside this venue's openworld prefab but no extracted vanilla phase ever activates it, so these stalls are unstaffed by default.
Second food-stall keeper, same 16 stand spots; two staffed stands plus shoppers read as an open bazaar.
Shoppers for the stalls (40 spots: look_at_products, sit_chair_can_drink, takeout barstool, stand_around). Supplies the buying side of the market without any quest NPC.
Construction worker at the bridge construction site, standing with a tablet (stand_ground_tablet__use). The site is permanent geometry; the worker keeps it reading as an active site in the daytime.
Second site worker, leaning on the site wall (dirt stand_wall_lean_back).

NCPD officer posted at the market rail (stand_rail_lean_front__stand_around), the market's routine police presence. Vanilla spawns ncpd_01 here for the market meeting and walks it off at the end of the phase; the same relaxed, non-hostile phase should stand here normally.
Second officer of the market post, leaning at the stand bar (stand_bar_lean_back). Same relaxed phase vanilla uses.

Shrine maiden at the route-side shrine, praying (church stand_ground__pray 02/04). Shrine staff are normal, not parade-only, and the shrine geometry is base-world; the spots live in #q112_pr_parade. Tour must confirm the shrine reads normally with the parade variants off.
Shrine priest meditating at the shrine (monk sit_ground__meditate 04). Keeps the shrine attended without any parade crowd.

variant_toggles.why: Parked AVs / parade vehicles off in the market section. Both q112 phases that touch this variant set 0; 0 is the only recorded state and matches an undressed market.
Remove the parade barricade so the route (and the shrine) is walkable, as it is after the job. Vanilla sets the blocker only while the parade runs.
No Hanako Arasaka parade float on the route: the funeral parade does not happen in this timeline. Vanilla hides it again after the abduction.
Whole frozen parade-crowd block off (563 nodes of instanced spectators on the route). 0 is the state vanilla restores after the parade.

proximity_wait.why: AccessPointControllerPS in the always-loaded loc_q112_parade_area_gameplay_prefab6ZLETJA/#loc_q112_parade_area_devices, the market security terminal by the security-room entrance the player passes on the way through the market. A resolved device entity, not a workspot (rule 8).
